# Controls (web)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

Controls: Standards, Every Requirement, the register, the library, the SoA, traceability and Across Frameworks.

## Files

- `ControlUpload.vue`: Upload controls from a CSV or Excel file.
- `ControlsPage.vue`: Controls, five tabs: standards in plain English (coverage per framework), the register (controls per use case), the library (reusable controls mapped to standards), the Statement of Applicability, and the traceability matrix from obligation to evidence.
- `HarmonizeTab.vue`: v1.7.3: one control, many frameworks.
- `RequirementsTab.vue`: v1.7.4: every requirement of each framework in scope, so "fully met" means what it says: each requirement is proven by a control (in place, tested, passing, evidenced) or marked not applicable with a reason.
- `StandardsTab.vue`: Standards, in plain English: each framework the engagement is measured against, what it asks for, and how far this engagement can prove it meets it.

## Pages

| Address | Page |
|---|---|
| `/controls/:tab(standards|requirements|register|library|soa|traceability|harmonize)` | `ControlsPage.vue` |

The server side is in [`apps/server/src/controls`](../../../../server/src/controls/README.md).
